transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, what brings me in is that my body just feels... out of my control. At first, I was pacing around the apartment all night, just walking back and forth making all these notes for a supper club. But lately, I'm just so slowed down. My sister is the one who pointed it out—she says it takes me forever just to get my shoes on now. I just don't know what's going on with how I'm moving.
During that time when you were staying up all night planning the supper club, did you feel unusually high, elated, or on top of the world?

Yeah, I did. It was actually right after I got fired from my job at the restaurant. You'd think I would be upset, but instead I just felt... I don't know, weirdly unstoppable. I was just really excited about everything. 

But it wasn't just a good feeling, really. If anyone questioned my plans, or if they told me I needed to slow down, I would just blow up at them. It honestly felt like they were trying to ruin my life, so I'd get really angry.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices or sounds that weren't there.
Lately, along with feeling slowed down, have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed?

No, not really. I mean, I'm definitely slowed down and it takes me a while to get things done, but I don't feel sad or depressed about it. I'm not crying or feeling down in the dumps or anything. It's just the physical part that's weird.
Before this recent experience, have you ever had any other periods in your life where you felt unusually energized and high, or deeply depressed?

No, not that I can think of. This is the first time I've ever felt anything like that... that whole unstoppable, energized thing. And I haven't ever had a period where I was deeply depressed, either. I mean, I've had normal good days and bad days, but nothing extreme. So, yeah, it's really just been this one recent time.
About how long did that period of feeling unstoppable and staying up all night last?

I'm not exactly sure, honestly. I wasn't really keeping track of the days because I was just going and going. It felt like a while, but I couldn't give you a specific number of days or weeks. It's all a bit of a blur.
Did that period become severe enough that you had to be admitted to the hospital?
No, I didn't go to the hospital or anything. I mean, I guess it got pretty intense, but... no, I wasn't admitted. I just sort of rode it out until it stopped.
During that time, did your behavior cause serious problems in your relationships, finances, or your ability to manage day-to-day responsibilities?

Yeah, it actually caused a lot of problems. I mean, I couldn't keep anything together. I missed a bunch of shifts at the restaurant, so work got really messed up. And... I couldn't even manage my rent or keep any of my promises to my family. It got so bad that my sister actually had to take me to a crisis clinic because I just couldn't organize my basic responsibilities anymore. Everything just kind of fell apart.

I just haven't really kept track of my moods that closely when I'm not feeling... well, when I'm not feeling like I did during that crazy period.
